mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.user_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),'五行朋友') author_name,u.avatar_url, c.content,c.parent_id,c.reply_to_user_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(ru.nickname,''),'') reply_to_name, c.user_id=#{viewerId} mine,c.create_time FROM diary_comment c JOIN app_user u ON u.id=c.user_id LEFT JOIN app_user ru ON ru.id=c.reply_to_user_id WHERE c.diary_id=#{diaryId} AND c.status='0' ORDER BY c.create_time,c.id

SELECT c.id,c.user_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),'五行朋友') author_name,u.avatar_url, c.content,c.parent_id,c.reply_to_user_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(ru.nickname,''),'') reply_to_name, TRUE mine,c.create_time FROM diary_comment c JOIN app_user u ON u.id=c.user_id LEFT JOIN app_user ru ON ru.id=c.reply_to_user_id WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.status='0'
SELECT COALESCE(parent_id,id) FROM diary_comment WHERE id=#{id} AND diary_id=#{diaryId} AND status='0'
